description: This file contains unit tests for the PublicNotices functionality in the AnySoftKeyboard project, verifying properties such as uniqueness, instance consistency, and immutability of public notices lists.

classes.name: PublicNoticesTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of public notices in the application, including uniqueness, instance sharing, and list immutability.

methods.name: testUniqueNames
methods.description: Verifies that all public notices have unique names and are not null or empty.

methods.name: testSameNoticesInstancesInTestingOfEachType
methods.description: Checks that the public notices list contains exactly one instance of each specific notice type and that the list size is as expected.

methods.name: testSameNoticesInstancesInProduction
methods.description: Ensures that multiple calls to getPublicNoticesProduction return different list objects but with the same notice instances.

methods.name: testCanNotChangePublicNoticesList
methods.description: Confirms that the production notices list is unmodifiable by attempting to remove an element, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testCanNotChangePublicNoticesListInTesting
methods.description: Confirms that the testing notices list is unmodifiable by attempting to remove an element, expecting an exception.
